summary.result: Overall, the soil moisture estimates showed the linear trends compared to the TDR measurements with the high Pearson's correlations (more than 0.7).
summary.background: In this study, we estimated the spatially-distributed soil moisture at the high resolution ( $10m{\times}10m$ ) using the satellite-based Sentinel-1A/B SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) sensor images.
summary.method: Then, the soil moisture values were estimated using the derived regression equations with the input data of Sentinel-1A/B based backscatter coefficients.
